messages.subject: Re: Editable data-table
parts:
I've recently worked on something similar and I've posted the demo code here (https://github.com/davidruvolo51/Rutils/blob/master/shinyapps/Data-Editor/app.R). I used the Rhandsontables as described in Joe's reply. 

In this example, the data used used is mtcars. I've written the code to "save" each edit and to create a backup of the pre-modified dataset. This was mandatory for the app that I built for quality control. There are also different "modes" in this demo (e.g., view, edit), which prevent accidental edits when viewing the data. You may also want to use shiny's showModal() and modalDialog() instead of the shinyBS package. I'll try to update the demo soon.

From here, you can view the data as it's updated (page refresh may be necessary) and generate additional graphics/features. 

Hope this helps. Good luck!

- David
